comment: CONTRAST corpus (2026-07-29, Becca-approved): pre-Elon Twitter careers copy for the before/after-Musk gender-language analysis. Deliberately NOT in pipeline.yaml — the universe auto-includes companies in site/story exports (export_gender_story/export_story_web/export_web all default to load_companies()), so this company is fetched/chunked/labeled STANDALONE and never exported. Post-Elon X lives in data/x/ (canon-primary, the Nov 2022 ultimatum) — a separate company by design; do not merge. CDX discovery 2026-07-29: careers.twitter.com is an AEM site (2016-2022); the ~7.6k 'distinct' URLs are almost all /en/work-for-twitter/{yyyymm}/{job}.html postings (EXCLUDED — listings) plus _jcr_content image assets; culture copy lives on the root, /en.html, tweep-life.html, work-for-twitter.html, diversity.html, early-career.html, and /en/locations/ city pages. about.twitter.com/careers is the prior Drupal-era site (2014-2018); /careers/positions (job postings) and /careers/jobvite_iframe_resize (iframe junk) EXCLUDED; /careers/locations city pages kept. PRE-ELON CUTOFF: max_year 2022 is year-granular, so any captures after 20221027 (acquisition close) are pruned from snapshots.json post-fetch — keep it that way. Known gap: twitter.com/jobs has CDX 2007-2013 (pre-careers-subdomain era) — candidate extension, not fetched (outside the probed scope).
